title: Extension by an essentially constant system preserves Mittag-Leffler (Stacks 070D)
statement: Let $0\to(A_i)\to(B_i)\to(C_i)\to0$ be a short exact sequence of inverse systems of abelian groups indexed by $i\ge1$ [def-weil-inverse-system] (morphisms of inverse systems $(A_i)\to(B_i)\to(C_i)$ such that $0\to A_i\to B_i\to C_i\to0$ is exact for every $i$). If $(C_i)$ is essentially constant [def-weil-pbc-essentially-constant-system], then $(A_i)$ is ML if and only if $(B_i)$ is ML [def-weil-pbc-mittag-leffler-system].

source.place: Homology, Lemma Tag 070D (lemma-exact-sequence-ML, homology.tex line 7761), with its proof lines 7771--7807 (uses Lemma 070C, lemma-essentially-constant, line 7733). Tags verified in tags/tags: 070D,homology-lemma-exact-sequence-ML; 070C,homology-lemma-essentially-constant

proof.text: Unpack essential constancy into X, cone maps pi_n, split index i0, retraction r and factorization witnesses. Write t^A, t^B, t^C for transitions, u for S.f, and v for S.g. Iterate the adjacent cone compatibility by induction on k >= j to obtain t^C_{k,j} pi_k = pi_j. Naturality gives u_j t^A_{k,j} = t^B_{k,j} u_k and v_j t^B_{k,j} = t^C_{k,j} v_k. Termwise short exactness gives injectivity of u, surjectivity of v, and ker(v)=im(u).

source.place: Homology, Tag 070D, direct elementwise implementation of its image-comparison proof

proof.text: If c is a factorization witness for j, functoriality shows every later k >= c also satisfies t^C_{k,j}=pi_j r t^C_{k,i0}. For m >= i0, cone compatibility and r pi_i0=id give r t^C_{m,i0} pi_m=id. Consequently pi_m is injective. These are the only properties of the splitting used; no auxiliary direct-sum or subgroup tower is needed.

source.place: Homology, Tag 070D, direct elementwise implementation of its image-comparison proof

proof.text: Forward implication: fix j and an ML witness i -> j for A. Choose c >= i,i0 with t^C_{c,i}=pi_i r t^C_{c,i0}. For b in B_c and any k >= j, set l=max(c,k) and x=r t^C_{c,i0} v_c(b). Lift pi_l(x) to d in B_l by surjectivity. Naturality and the cone equality imply v_i(t^B_{c,i}b - t^B_{l,i}d)=pi_i(x)-pi_i(x)=0. Exactness gives a in A_i whose u_i-image is this difference.

source.place: Homology, Tag 070D, direct elementwise implementation of its image-comparison proof

proof.text: The ML witness for A gives a prime in A_k with t^A_{k,j}(a prime)=t^A_{i,j}(a). Then t^B_{l,k}(d)+u_k(a prime) maps to t^B_{c,j}(b): expand the sum, use naturality of u and the preceding difference identity, and cancel the two t^B_{l,j}(d) terms. Thus the image of B_c -> B_j lies in every image of B_k -> B_j, which is exactly Mathlib ML.

source.place: Homology, Tag 070D, direct elementwise implementation of its image-comparison proof

proof.text: Reverse implication: fix j, let m=max(j,i0), take a B-ML witness i -> m, and choose c=max(i,m). For a in A_c and arbitrary k >= j, choose a common l beyond factorization witnesses for k and m (and c). B-ML at m supplies b in B_l with t^B_{l,m}(b)=u_m(t^A_{c,m}(a)). Thus t^C_{l,m}(v_l(b))=0. Put x=r t^C_{l,i0}(v_l(b)). The factorization into m gives pi_m(x)=0, hence x=0 by the injectivity of pi_m. Factorization into k then gives v_k(t^B_{l,k}(b))=pi_k(x)=0.

source.place: Homology, Tag 070D, direct elementwise implementation of its image-comparison proof

proof.text: Exactness at k supplies a prime in A_k with u_k(a prime)=t^B_{l,k}(b). Map to j. Naturality, the equality at m, and functoriality imply u_j(t^A_{k,j}(a prime))=u_j(t^A_{c,j}(a)); injectivity of u_j cancels it. The image of A_c -> A_j therefore lies in every image of A_k -> A_j. This proves A is ML. Combine both implications; all indices, including those before i0, were covered directly.
